description: Search published Prague event facts, including ongoing programmes. Cite each event’s HelloCityOwl url and use originalUrl for the organiser’s programme. A date without a clock time has no confirmed start time.

dateFrom.description: First Prague calendar day, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD.

dateTo.description: Last Prague calendar day, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Multi-day events are included if their dates overlap.

language.description: Event language. Defaults to English on .com and Czech on .cz.

query.description: Words in the title, venue or category. All words must match, ignoring accents and case. Try DOX or music.

name: search_prague_events
title: Search Prague events
